transcript.text: Hi everyone, before I finalize and send the specs to production for Aria Vale's remote segment, I need to check in with our broadcast engineer and rights manager. Are there any production requirements or clearance issues we need to address for the live 20-minute stream segment?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Maya, I need to flag a critical production issue. My post-rehearsal network test showed that the venue cannot maintain reliable two-way latency for a live performance. However, it can reliably play an artist-approved file — but that file must be exactly 7 minutes or shorter, delivered as 1080p SDR with stereo audio. I completed this test after the last production meeting and haven't entered the result in the production log yet. This means the currently planned live 20-minute segment is not feasible with our network conditions.
